what: Lloyds Banking Group is Britain's largest retail bank. It owns Lloyds Bank, Halifax and Bank of Scotland, holds the biggest share of UK mortgages, and also runs the insurer Scottish Widows.
customers: UK households, savers, mortgage borrowers, small businesses and corporate clients.
money: current accounts, mortgages, cards and consumer lending
business lending, transaction banking and markets
Scottish Widows life, pensions and investments
moat: The largest base of UK current accounts, which cost almost nothing and fund the biggest mortgage book in the country.
risks: It is almost entirely exposed to the UK economy
An investigation into motor finance commissions has required large provisions
Bank levies and taxes in the UK are high
opportunities: Its structural hedge keeps rolling into higher-yielding positions, lifting income for several years
A dividend yield above 4% with large buybacks on top
watch: Net interest margin and the final cost of the motor finance review.
